name: C-PAC
summary: Runs the C-PAC (Configurable Pipeline for the Analysis of Connectomes) BIDS App on a T1w image and task fMRI, with the default or a preconfigured pipeline, and outputs the C-PAC derivatives.
description: Pulls the latest C-PAC Singularity image, converts the brainlife inputs to BIDS with bl2bids and runs C-PAC at participant level. Choose a preconfigured pipeline with preconfig, otherwise the default pipeline runs. Use it for fMRI preprocessing and connectome derivatives; expect long run times (up to 48 h).

outputs.description: C-PAC output directory (derivatives and logs; working directory if saveWorkingDir is set).

parameters.description: For a list of and descriptions of available preconfigured pipelines, see https://fcp-indi.github.io/docs/latest/user/preconfig
Save the Nipype working directory (which can be quite large). By default only outputs are retained.
